<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="JKMDwPOtD3x-8JMoJJDH"> <mxGraphModel dx="1535" dy="845" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="827" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart LR
 %% External Entities (Boundary Anchors)
 E_Manager([\"Farm Manager\"]):::entityNode

 %% Data Store
 D1[(\"D1: User Accounts\n& Roles Store\")]:::storeNode

 %% 3 Sub-Processes (Strictly matching WBS 1.1 - 1.3 Verbs)
 P1_1((\"1.1\nRegister & Provision\nUser Accounts\")):::processNode
 P1_2((\"1.2\nAdminister Role-Based\nAccess Control (RBAC)\")):::processNode
 P1_3((\"1.3\nManage User Profiles &\nAuthentication Sessions\")):::processNode

 %% Boundary Data Flows (Balanced with Diagram 0)
 E_Manager -->|\"User registration details\"| P1_1
 E_Manager -->|\"Role assignments\"| P1_2

 %% Internal Data Flows & Store Connections
 P1_1 -->|\"Write user credentials\"| D1
 P1_2 -->|\"Write role privileges\"| D1
 
 D1 -->|\"Read user permissions\"| P1_3
 P1_3 -->|\"Write active session states\"| D1

 classDef storeNode fill:#fef3c7,stroke:#d97706,stroke-width:2px,color:#b45309,font-weight:bold,font-size:11px;",
 "config": null,
